rows.grounds: Numeral element forming the compound number eighty-four thousand.
Locative plural indicating the vast number in which torment occurs.
Compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (diagram/device), denoting realms or mechanisms of birth.
Past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering.

items.question: Within how many womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
The locations of suffering are womb-diagrams.
Beings in these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across an immense multitude of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
